items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: I recorded quite a bit of the names. Tony Peretti and Georgie Brunas.

ctx.x: That's on the record, by the way. The Gene Norman Presents record is still available.

It's still available. But we really laid him in the aisle and it gave those boys a nice break. It gave Georgie Girard a good break. And like I say, George could have went on to big and better things if Miss Fortune wouldn't have took him and passed away. But I get a kick out of trying to help a few of the boys. If I can do anything to give them just a little bit of help. Like I said, Bill, Dixieland's in my heart. I love it. I guess I always will. And I like the music and I like the boys. And if I can help them…

I was going to ask, do you know of anyone else we could interview about the New Orleans Rhythm Kings? Are there any other of your relatives, family that could tell us anything about Paul's history? Any better than not that I'm, I don't mean that. Well, I don't think so. I mean, anybody would have other angles on him or anything, you know, that would knew him? No, I took, I took
